title: Australian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and comforting lamb stew originating from Australia, perfect for a cold evening. This recipe uses earthy flavors and a rich broth to bring out the best in the lamb.

ingredients.name: Australian lamb shoulder, cut into 2-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Look for lamb shoulder with a good balance of fat and lean meat

ingredients.name: Onion, chopped
ingredients.notes: You can use a sweet onion like Vidalia or a yellow onion

ingredients.name: Carrots, peeled and chopped
ingredients.notes: Use a variety like Nantes or Danver for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Potatoes, peeled and chopped
ingredients.notes: Choose high-starch potatoes like Russet or Idaho

ingredients.name: Red wine, such as Cabernet Sauvignon
ingredients.notes: You can also use beef broth if you prefer

ingredients.name: Beef broth
ingredients.notes: Use a low-sodium broth to avoid overpowering the stew

ingredients.name: Tomato paste
ingredients.notes: Look for a high-quality tomato paste with minimal added ingredients

ingredients.name: Thyme
ingredients.notes: Choose fresh thyme for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Rosemary
ingredients.notes: Use fresh rosemary for the best flavor

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb cubes in batches until they're nicely browned on all sides. Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it's softened and lightly browned.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the chopped potatoes and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the red wine to the pot and cook until it's almost completely reduced.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, thyme, and rosemary to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew, covered, for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
